name: STAR Statistics — median, quantiles, IQR and MAD, correctly rounded
summary: Median, Hyndman-Fan type 7 quantile, interquartile range and median absolute deviation computed exactly in rational arithmetic and rounded once; on 500 datasets (2000 values) every value is identical to the exact rational value from SymPy, and NumPy, SciPy and CPython statistics agree within 7e-16 of the largest value.
reference: worked example of the median absolute deviation, data (1, 1, 2, 2, 4, 6, 9): median 2, MAD 1; Hyndman and Fan (1996) definition 7: quartiles of 1..5 are 2 and 4

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-04: q in [0, 1]; quantile definition 7 of Hyndman and Fan; MAD not scaled
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input; stated that other packages may default to another of the nine quantile definitions and that the MAD is unscaled
